# MOD Mediations (Mediators on Demand, LLC)

> Neutral mediation and arbitration for high-stakes commercial, corporate, tort, and bankruptcy disputes across Texas and Oklahoma.

## About

MOD Mediations provides alternative dispute resolution (ADR) services including mediation and arbitration. The firm is a separate entity from Newark Law Offices, though both are directed by Robert C. Newark, III, Esq.

## Services

- Commercial and corporate ADR
- High-value tort mediation
- Bankruptcy workouts and debtor/creditor disputes
- Virtual and in-person mediation sessions

## Service Areas

Texas: Dallas, Houston, Fort Worth, Austin, San Antonio, and statewide.
Oklahoma: Oklahoma City, Edmond, Tulsa, Norman, and statewide.

## Offices
